description_en: ID Verification provides face deepfake detection capabilities, which can be integrated independently through API calls
description_zh: ID Verification 提供了人脸Deepfake检测能力，可以通过接口的形式单独接入
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl deepfake-detect-intl-stream --product-code FACE_DEEPFAKE --merchant-biz-id e0c34a000353888 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeepfakeDetectIntlStream

parameters.help_en:
The product solution to integrate.
Valid value: FACE_DEEPFAKE
parameters.help_zh:
要接入的产品方案。
取值：FACE_DEEPFAKE
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
A custom verification scenario ID that you define. This ID is used to query related records in the console.

The value is a combination of letters, digits, or underscores (_) with a maximum length of 10 characters
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录使用。

支持长度为10位的字母、数字或下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is an alphanumeric string with a length of 32 characters.

The first few characters consist of a custom abbreviation defined by the merchant, the middle part can contain a timestamp, and the last part can use a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh:
商户请求的唯一标识，值为32位长度的字母数字组合。

其中前几位字符由商户自定义的简称组成，中间部分可以包含一段时间，而后段可以采用随机或递增序列
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of facial material input:

IMAGE (default): Face image
VIDEO: Face video

Note
Video processing takes a long time. We recommend that you set the timeout period to more than 3 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
人脸素材输入类型：

IMAGE（默认）：人脸图片
VIDEO：人脸视频

说明
视频处理时间较久，建议超时时间设置>3S
parameters.name: face_input_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face image
parameters.name: face_url

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded face image. For videos, we recommend that you use the stream method for transmission
parameters.help_zh: 传入人脸图片的Base64格式编码，视频格式建议通过流方式传入
parameters.name: face_base64

Result.description_en:
The risk result:

0: Low risk
1: High risk
2: Suspicious
Result.description_zh:
风险结果：

0：低风险
1：高风险
2：可疑

additionalProperties.description_en: The score for each corresponding risk label when a risk is detected
additionalProperties.description_zh: 命中风险时返回对应标签分数

RiskTag.description_en:
The risk labels. Multiple labels are separated by commas (,), including:

SuspectDeepForgery: Suspected deep forgery
SuspectPSFace: Suspected face synthesis attack
SuspectTemple: Suspected template attack
SuspectRemake: Suspected presentation attack
RiskTag.description_zh:
风险标签。多个标签使用半角逗号（,）隔开，包括：

SuspectDeepForgery：疑似深度伪造
SuspectPSFace：疑似合成攻击
SuspectTemple：疑似模板攻击
SuspectRemake：疑似呈现攻击
